rows.note: Use 物種 as the all-purpose term for a biological species or the species rank.

example.english: This butterfly species is common in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢種蝴蝶係香港常見嘅物種。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 wu4 dip6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 mat6 zung2

rows.note: Use 種 as the shorter taxonomic label when discussing species as a rank in biological classification.

example.english: In biological classification, species is a rank below genus.
example.traditional: 喺生物分類學入面，種係低過屬嘅一級。
example.jyutping: hai2 sang1 mat6 fan1 leoi6 hok6 jap6 min6 zung2 hai6 dai1 gwo3 suk6 ge3 jat1 kap1
